issue_context.title: circular import prevents pytest tests for my own integration
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I'm trying to write a integration for Home Assistant with pytest that check, if my code is working correct. But when i import my implementation into a pytest, i get an error message, that home assistant can't be imported due circular imports (see error message below)


### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2.5.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

don't know

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

none, testing code for a new one

These styling changes are not related to the issue presented, please revert these.

If you like the PR another branch, you'll need a new PR.
I've pushed the correct branch to my dev branch, too. Is this ok for you? If not, just close this PR and i'll start a new one. And once again sorry for opening the PR for the wrong branch.
Please revert the changes in this file, these are not related to circular import issues.
